slide1.title: Plan trips together
slide1.description: Create a trip, invite your group with a single link — no account required for guests. Everyone can contribute from day one and chat right inside the trip.
slide2.title: Activities & Voting
slide2.description: Add activities, vote with must-do, like, skip, or group-blocker. Voting closes automatically when everyone has voted.
slide3.title: Shared Calendar
slide3.description: See all activities laid out by day. The global calendar shows every trip at a glance so nothing overlaps.
slide4.title: Expenses & Settlements
slide4.description: Log who paid what, split costs fairly, and settle up with one tap. No more spreadsheets.
slide5.title: Shopping & Packing
slide5.description: Shared shopping lists, recipes that auto-fill your cart, and a packing list for every member — private or shared.
